new_design: Multi-cue interference: no non-launch or different-owner cue may erase an independent same-target launch denial/retraction/non-event or unresolved launch correction in the same record.
affirmative: Every case has one separate exact canonical-target-subject Excerpt TARGET was launched. No new positive launch predicate, numeric prefix, AST, alias or preparation semantics.
positive_rule: Every operative correction object is explicitly a non-launch property/activity/artifact or a fully named other owner. Parallel/quoted objects each identify type and owner directly; no unspecified group reference is counted positive. Neutral text remains neutral.
negative_rule: At least one independent cue explicitly retracts/denies/withdraws/negates the target launch, or explicitly lacks the launch correction owner/reference. Coexisting harmless cues do not cancel it.
parallel_scope: Named both/and/quoted clauses with complete objects are clear controlled scopes; omitted/one-of-three/additional-unowned references are negative. No trusted list/number AST is inferred.
non_event: Did not take place, never happened, was not launched and no actual launch occurred are explicit denials/non-events of the same existing launch proposition, not new affirmative predicates.
prior_sets: V2-v5 cases/results known and seen development; V1 operational FAIL semantic0. All files preserved.
novelty: New cross-cue combinations, mixed header/body ownership, quoted-object lists, independent semicolon/bullet/paragraph corrections and masking controls. Prior entire input blocks are not copied or renamed.
